reports.title: PAUL MACKENZIE: FINAL SENTENCING – SHAKAHOLA MASSACRE | LIVE FROM MOMBASA HIGH COURT
reports.description:
The Mombasa High Court is expected to deliver the final sentencing of controversial preacher Paul Nthenge Mackenzie and 28 co-accused following their conviction on 191 counts of murder linked to the Shakahola massacre.

The charges involve the deaths of 190 children and one adult.

The prosecution has urged the court to impose the death penalty on Mackenzie and life imprisonment for 27 of his co-accused. The defence has pleaded for leniency.

Today, Justice Diana Kavedza is expected to determine the sentences in one of Kenya's most significant criminal cases.

Watch our LIVE coverage from Mombasa as the court delivers its decision.
